user: Create a new sample `standard-grid.tsx` with a barebone flat grid. Load the NYC Payroll CSV into a **separate** in browser datasource, take the schema definition from existing pivot grid in samples, downsample to 50K rows as preprocessing step, and inject clustered nulls (1% of rows dirty, 30% of columns nulled - skip Payroll Number and Agency Name). Render a basic grid with defaults
claude:
Created `standard-grid.tsx` with a self-contained dirty datasource:
- `useDirtyDataSource()` hook — creates an independent `DataSource`, loads CSV with `CLEAN_SCHEMA` (15 columns: dimensions + measures with temporal/decimal subtypes), applies `buildReplaceMap()` for cleaning `$`, `,`, `''`, and `makePreprocess(50000)` for downsampling
- Null injection: marks ~1% rows dirty via `random() < 0.01`, nulls ~30% of columns in dirty rows, drops temp `__dirty__` column
- `StandardGrid` component using `SqlStandardTableDataModel` + `FlattenedDataViewModel`, initial fetch of 10K rows, `viewDataEmpty` handler for scroll pagination
- Registered sample in `index.ts`
state_desc: Barebone flat grid with 50K downsampled rows and clustered null injection

user:
Add a custom cell renderer that:
- Highlights null cells with a light red background and shows "null" in red italic
- Left-aligns dimensions, right-aligns measures
- Rounds numbers and formats with locale separators
- Shows dates as `yyyy-mm-dd`
- Shows `$` prefix for salary/pay columns and `hrs` prefix for hour columns using a `space-between` layout; make prefix text smaller and faded
claude:
Added `qualityCellRenderer: CellRenderer<unknown>` with per-column formatting:
- Uses `CLEAN_SCHEMA[dataCtx.colIndex]` to determine column type
- **Nulls**: `backgroundColor: rgba(232,99,110,0.12)`, red italic "null" text
- **Alignment**: `ctx.container.style.justifyContent` — `flex-start` for dimensions, `flex-end` for measures, `space-between` when unit prefix is present
- **Formatting**: `formatCellValue` helper — `Intl.NumberFormat` for measures, manual `yyyy-mm-dd` for temporals
- **Unit prefixes**: `getUnit()` returns `$` for money columns (Base Salary, Regular Gross Paid, Total OT Paid, Total Other Pay) and `hrs` for hour columns (Regular Hours, OT Hours)
- Wired via `GridDataViewModelOptions.vTrackDefs` — one `{ renderer: qualityCellRenderer }` per column
state_desc: Custom cell renderer with null highlighting, alignment, number formatting, and unit prefixes

user:
Add a top horizontal fixture - a thin stacked bar per column showing valid (bluish) vs missing (redish) proportions. [Shreenshot attached]. Use zero padding, no border radius, and ensure the missing segment has a minimum 4px width so even 1% is visible. Show valid/missing counts on hover tooltip.

Add a metadata plumber that computes this information.
claude:
Added metadata plumbing and quality bar fixture:
- `createQualityPlumber(): StandardMetadataPlumber` — global resolver runs `COUNT(*) - COUNT("field")` SQL per column to get missing counts, reshaper maps into per-column `{ total, missing }` metadata
- `QualityBarFixture extends PHorizontalFixture` — 12px tall, reads `metadata.getValueColumnMeta(colIndex)` for total/missing. Each cell: flex row with blue (`#03A9F4`) valid segment and red (`#e8636e`) missing segment. Missing has `min-width: 4px`. Tooltip: "Valid: N\nMissing: N"
- Passed plumber to `SqlStandardTableDataModel` constructor, added `metadata` to `FlattenedDataViewModel` and `updateData` calls
state_desc: Top fixture with per-column valid/missing stacked bars powered by metadata plumbing

Add a metadata plumber that computes the statistics/distribution.
claude:
Extended the metadata plumber and added `HistogramFixture`:
- **Plumber extension**: global resolver now also queries `GROUP BY ... ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 8` for dimension top values, and bucketed `MIN/MAX/FLOOR` histogram SQL for measure distributions (8 bins). Reshaper stores `topValues`, `histBins`, `min`, `max`, `schemaType`, `fieldName` per column
- `HistogramFixture extends PHorizontalFixture` — 138px tall, positioned above `QualityBarFixture` in `fixtures.top`
  - **Dimension columns**: `renderDimensionBars()` — horizontal bars with "Top N values" header, bars sized proportionally via flex, labels with ellipsis, tooltips with Count and Value
  - **Measure columns**: `renderMeasureBars()` — vertical bars aligned to bottom, even tick labels rotated 45deg, tooltips with Count and Value range
- Added `C_DIST_BAR = "#607D8B"`, `NUM_BINS = 8`, `fmtNum()` for compact number formatting

user: Add drag-to-select interaction on measure histograms. Clicking and dragging creates a range selection overlay with resize handles and a close button. The selection filters the data by adding `gte`/`lte` filter predicates to the IR and re-fetching. Cache original column metadata so histograms stay stable when filters change. [Screenshot attached].
claude:
Added interactive histogram filtering:
- **Selection state** (module-level): `histogramSelections: Map<number, HistogramRange>` tracks `{field, valMin, valMax}` per column, `originalColMeta` caches first-fetch metadata so histograms render from original distribution
- **Drag interaction** (`setupHistogramDrag`): mousedown on histogram cell — creates range on drag, pans overlay on existing selection, resize via left/right edge handles, close button (×) removes selection. Tiny selections (<0.5% of range) discarded
- **Selection overlay** (`renderSelectionOverlay`): positioned via CSS `calc()` for correct rendering even on virtualization re-create. Semi-transparent box with resize handles and close button
- **Filtering**: `onHistogramSelectionChange` callback builds `gte`/`lte` `ScalarFilter` predicates, re-fetches via `getViewModelData` with updated IR. `viewDataEmpty` handler also carries histogram filters
- `HistogramFixture.renderMeasureBars` now calls `setupHistogramDrag` and `renderSelectionOverlay` at end, reads from `originalColMeta` when available
concept_used: Headless Grid Architecture; Fixtures; Metadata Layer
state_desc: Drag-to-select range filter on measure histograms with cached metadata

user: Add a right vertical fixture that shows a small colored rectangle per row - red if the row has any null, green otherwise. On hover, show a tooltip listing the null column names with count separated by newline. [Screenshot attached]
claude:
Added page-wise metadata and quality dot fixture:
- **Page-wise plumber**: resolver emits `CASE WHEN "field" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END` SQL expression per column via `SqlSelectExpression`. Reshaper maps null flags into per-cell `{ quality: "missing" }` via `StandardPageCellMetadata`
- `QualityDotFixture extends PVerticalFixture` — right fixture:
  - Header: "Q" with tooltip "Row data quality"
  - Each row: 6×10px rectangle — red (`#e8636e`) if any column has null (checked via `metadata.getValueCellMeta(c, rowIndex)`), green (`#03A9F4`) otherwise
  - Tooltip on red dots: "N null values\nBase Salary\nOT Hours\n..." listing null column names from `metadata.getValueColumnMeta(c).fieldName`
concept_used: Headless Grid Architecture; Fixtures; Metadata Layer

user: Add a right vertical fixture using a canvas element. It should span all visible rows as a single cell. Use the global minimap metadata (300 buckets) to paint bands - red intensity proportional to null density (normalized min-max), green if clean. Clicking the canvas should scroll to the corresponding row. [Screenshot attached]
claude:
Added minimap metadata and canvas fixture:
- **Plumber extension**: global resolver now runs a bucketed SQL query (300 buckets) counting rows with any null per bucket. Stored on first column's metadata as `minimap: Array<{ bucket, nullCount, totalCount }>`
- `MinimapFixture extends PVerticalFixture` — fixed 8px wide via `get colSize()`, renders a single `<canvas>` spanning all visible rows:
  - Each of 300 minimap buckets maps directly to a pixel band (`bandH = height / minimap.length`)
  - Clean buckets: `C_VALID` (#03A9F4 blue)
  - Dirty buckets: `rgba(232,99,110, alpha)` where alpha is normalized density (0.2–0.8 range)
  - Click handler: calculates `targetRow` from click fraction, calls `minimapGridRef.scrollTo("row", targetRow)`
  - Applies `canvas.style.transform = translateY(offsetY)` to counteract scroll jitter
- Set `minimapGridRef` after grid creation, cleaned up on unmount
concept_used: Headless Grid Architecture; Fixtures; Metadata Layer

user:
Add interactivity to dimension distribution bars:
- Click a bar to toggle filter (selected values use `IN()` predicate)
- Multiple bars can be selected across columns (AND logic with histogram filters)
- Selected bars: highlighted blue with border, bold label; unselected bars dimmed
- Show a filter icon in column facet header for dimension columns with active filters
- Filter icon opens a popover showing active filter values as pills with × remove buttons
- Popover has Clear (removes all + refetches), Cancel (closes), and Apply (commits changes + refetches) CTAs
- Theme: background `#42A5F5`, color white, border `#0288D1`, buttons white with `#42A5F5` text
claude:
Major feature adding dimension filtering:
- **Selection state**: `dimensionSelections: Map<string, Set<string>>`, `DIMENSION_FIELDS_WITH_HIST` set, `buildAllFilters()` helper combining histogram `gte/lte` and dimension `IN()` into `ScalarFilter[]`
- **Bar toggle** (`renderDimensionBars`): click handler toggles value in `dimensionSelections`, calls `applyDimensionBarStyles()` for immediate visual feedback (data attributes `data-dim-val`, `data-dim-bar`, `data-dim-label` on DOM elements). Selected: blue `#42A5F5` bar + `#0288D1` border + bold label. Unselected when filter active: `opacity: 0.35`
- **Column header** (`colTrackRenderer: FacetCellRenderer`): for dimension columns with active filters, returns `{ content: data, right: filterIcon }` — funnel SVG icon with blue highlight background, click opens popover via `setFilterPopoverRef`
- **`DimensionFilterPopover`** React component: fixed-positioned below icon, shows filter value pills with × remove, Clear/Cancel/Apply buttons. Clear removes all + refetches + closes. Apply commits remaining values + refetches + closes
- **Shared refetch** (`refetchAndDraw` callback): centralized data fetch using `buildAllFilters()`, used by both `onHistogramSelectionChange` and `onDimensionSelectionChange`
- Added `modelRef`, `viewModelRef`, `irRef` to component for shared access across callbacks
concept_used: Headless Grid Architecture; Grid Config API;
state_desc: Interactive dimension bar filters with popover management and combined filter predicates
